resolutions: Customary-present agentive nominalization starts from an exact owner-issued customary-present VNC Result.
The complete canonical VNC Result, Source analysis, predicate frame, class, valence, voice, and participants remain preserved through capture.
Copied Results, JSON lookalikes, formulas, surfaces, and examples cannot authorize nominalization.
A present, preterit, future, or other wrong-tense VNC Result cannot enter the customary-present agentive conversion.
Reanalysis and full nominalization remain two typed degrees of customary-present agentive formation.
The degree is a genuine operation choice rather than a choice of example stem or displayed formula.
The complete customary-present predicate is reanalyzed as the restricted-use nounstem.
The customary-present tense morph ni remains the final constituent of the reanalyzed nounstem.
Internal projective objects remain inside the reanalyzed nounstem.
Internal reflexive objects remain subject-matched inside the reanalyzed nounstem.
The source subject and number contrast continue into the resulting NNC.
Typed monomorphemic and polymorphemic Source shapes use the same productive rule.
Changing an unlisted valid Source shape while holding clause facts constant does not change nominalization eligibility.
Changing owner identity or tense while holding the Source spelling constant blocks the conversion.
The fully nominal customary-agentive Source enters the ordinary NNC state owner.
Absolutive and possessive state use the same captured agentive Source without reconstructing it from a string.
Subject and possessor remain separate typed participants in possessive state.
Singular and plural realization, agreement carriers, and boundaries are derived by the canonical NNC owner.
Groups 1 through 3 add no manual ni, number-suffix, predicate-copy, example-stem, formula, or surface controls.
A static completion flag is insufficient; the live route must retain the exact captured VNC Result and reach an authorized or explicit repairable endpoint.
Customary and preterit agentives remain distinct typed analyses even when their English translations overlap.
A possessive customary-agentive form is supplied automatically by an exact preterit-agentive Result from the same typed lexical Source.
Copied or mismatched preterit Results cannot supply the customary-agentive possessive stem.
An owner-issued passive customary-present VNC Result licenses the customary-present patientive.
The customary-present patientive names the patient or undergoer and can carry the worthy-of-treatment extension without merging with potential patientive or instrumentive grammar.
The customary-present patientive is restricted to absolutive state and cannot activate a projective object outside the nominalized predicate.
A mainline reflexive in the patientive or instrumentive source moves automatically to the shuntline as ne.
Passive long ō remains protected before customary ni, while other passive Source-shape variants stay productive without an example whitelist.
The customary-present patientive is a full tl Subclass 1-A noun with structural singular ⎕-0 and plural m-eh.
A complete instrumentive paradigm requires exact customary-present impersonal and imperfect active VNC Results from one typed lexical Source.
The instrumentive absolutive uses the impersonal customary-present Result and imports a separate nonanimate common NNC subject.
The instrumentive possessive uses the imperfect active Result and converts its source subject to the possessor automatically.
The source subject cannot be replaced by a caller-selected possessor in the possessive instrumentive pathway.
Instrument, means, and faculty readings remain lexical or contextual and are never inferred from Source spelling alone.
The two-source instrumentive plan produces one pointwise-equivalent twelve-coordinate paradigm rather than two disconnected partial paradigms.
Instrumentive realization consumes exact owner-issued VNC morphemic shape, boundaries, participants, voice, tense, and Source analysis.
Instrumentive absolutive and possessive paths keep their distinct customary-impersonal and imperfect-active Sources.
Licensed hua and hua-lō variants must arrive through the exact VNC Result rather than an instrumentive suffix choice.
Supportive initial i behavior after tla or ne is inherited automatically from the VNC Source owner.
Instrumentive lexicalizations require lexical or contextual evidence and are never inferred from shape alone.
Instrumentive nounstems name broad set-defined classes rather than one fixed English device type.
Changing to another valid typed Source shape while keeping clause facts valid preserves instrumentive eligibility.
The present agentive captures an exact owner-issued active present VNC Result.
The complete present predicate becomes an absolutive nounstem with the present zero as its final constituent.
Present-agentive subject, number, objects, reflexive agreement, incorporated material, and boundaries remain typed.
